'''Akim's Munch''' was a street cafe located in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]]. Despite often serving undercooked and stringy [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]], that cafe had its regulars, including [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]], a renowned [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|Podracer]]. Before his defeat in the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]], Sebulba often hung out here, bragging of his victories to the great delight of his fans.<ref name="Inside">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]''</ref> [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] was sitting in the cafe in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] when [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] was attacked by Sebulba and subsequently saved by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].<ref name="Episode I" />

It sometimes hosted a [[Unidentified Bith band|Bith band]] and the [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] [[Musician/Legends|musician]] [[Tili Tili]]. Notable patrons were an [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]], a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]], a [[Morseerian/Legends|Morseerian]], a [[Unidentified two-headed patron|being with two heads]], and a brick red-colored beaked being.<ref name="YCAC">''[[Star Wars: Yoda's Challenge Activity Center]]''</ref> Around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] 32 BBY,<ref name="Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> a [[Unidentified young new recruit|young Jedi recruit]] visited the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] to record songs for the the benefit of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].<ref name="YCAC" />
